ranch: Rancho Simi (Rancho San Jose de Nuestra Senora de Altagracia y Simi)
region: Simi Valley, Ventura County (and western Los Angeles County), California
note_on_land: Rancho Simi lay primarily in present-day Ventura County (108,674.93 ac) with a smaller portion (4,334.28 ac) in Los Angeles County. Distinct from the Orange County city 'Rancho Santa Margarita' and from the San Diego 'Santa Margarita y Las Flores' (Camp Pendleton). All items below depict the Ventura/LA-County Rancho Simi land grant, patented to Jose de la Guerra y Noriega in 1865.

physical_only_collections: Simi Valley Historical Society & Museum at Strathearn Historical Park -- 137 Strathearn Place, Simi Valley, CA 93065 (mailing: Box 351, Simi Valley, CA 93065); web simihistory.com; phone (805) 526-6453. Holds original Strathearn-family ranch photographs, letters, artifacts, and the Simi Adobe/Strathearn House (Ventura County Landmark No. 6). Managed with Rancho Simi Recreation and Park District. Many images are digitized on Calisphere via Museum of Ventura County, but originals and much unpublished material are physical-only.

Museum of Ventura County, Research Library -- 100 E. Main Street, Ventura, CA 93001; venturamuseum.org (photo portal photographs.venturamuseum.org). Holds the archival collection 'Rancho Las Posas and Simi records, circa 1870-1930' (agreements, deeds/titles, leases, reports and surveys, correspondence) -- OAC/ArchivesSpace finding aid https://venturamuseum-archives.libraryhost.com/repositories/2/resources/19 and https://oac.cdlib.org/institutions/Museum+of+Ventura+County -- largely physical/manuscript. Copyright on most digitized photos is 'not determined'; contact library staff for rights and higher-res reproductions.
dead_ends: David Rumsey Map Collection (davidrumsey.com) -- search 'Rancho Simi' / 'Simi Land & Water': no distinct Rancho Simi grant map surfaced in results (the Simi Land & Water map is held by Huntington, not Rumsey).
USC Digital Library (digitallibrary.usc.edu) -- 'Rancho Simi' / 'Strathearn' / 'Pico': no specific Rancho Simi ranch item found.

Library of Congress (loc.gov Maps + Prints & Photographs + HABS/HAER) -- no HABS record for the Simi Adobe/Strathearn House; LOC Ventura County maps are modern (e.g. 1972-73 Conejo/Simi Valley street map), not ranch-era Rancho Simi.
UCLA Library Special Collections -- only 1960s Simi Valley aerials surfaced (via Calisphere), no ranch-operation photographs.

Automated PDF retrieval from CSUMB Hornbeck (digitalcommons.csumb.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi) -- HTTP 403 (bepress bot protection) for all GLO 400 article files; documents are PD but require manual browser download.

Calisphere item detail pages began returning HTTP 403 (rate limiting) after ~10 fetches; some subdivision-map item-level rights confirmations deferred to the Museum of Ventura County standard statement.
